'''2001 Roseville Enduro''' was a Star Wars CCG enduro held at A-1 Comics, Roseville, CA on 10 March 2001. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1870">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-10-01-enduro-1st-quarterd1870/ 3-10-01-enduro-1st-quarter], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-10-01-enduro-1st-quarterd1870/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' A-1 Comics, Roseville, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 40
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Michael Mendoza's report gives Paul Feldman's final record as 15–1 (11–1 after three Quarters), while Nick Stefanko's 4th Quarter report says Feldman 'went undefeated through all of them'.<ref name="tr-d1896" />
